positive: Bounded OSS scanning consistently produced objective-oracle supply: the daily qualification target was met on six of seven days and nearly met on the seventh.
The queue accumulated 16 still-eligible candidates without expanding repository scope or cash spend.
The system preserved a failed transfer attempt and did not mislabel it as efficacy evidence.
negative: The scientific objective was not met: 0 verified independent cases versus a 7-10 target.
Supply work outran execution: 79 reviews and 20 qualified observations produced only one start and zero completed replays.
The consumer trust configuration failed closed as designed but prevented task execution for most of the window.
Cloud budget enforcement failed on two days; unknown costs were detected only after commitments.

post_window_scan.decision: Do not queue additional supply while #3076 remains READY and backlog is sufficient.

model_strength_transfer.evidence: Protocol readiness exists; actual transfer evidence remains zero.

DEV_EXECUTION.hypothesis: Verifier-bound Experience can improve objective developer task success, reliability, or cost.
DEV_EXECUTION.strongest_evidence: 16 objective-oracle candidates remain and #3076 has immutable pre/post commits plus a discriminating regression oracle.
DEV_EXECUTION.strongest_counterevidence: No completed replay or valid paired test in the window.
DEV_EXECUTION.human_intervention_requirement: Operational repair of budget admission and code isolation; no external outreach.
DEV_EXECUTION.expected_validation_cost: 45 local agent-minutes for the existing READY replay, subject to admission.
DEV_EXECUTION.plausible_buyer_user: SDK/framework maintainers and coding-agent evaluation teams.
DEV_EXECUTION.next_most_informative_action: One valid scheduled #3076 replay before the existing deadline.

CONSUMER_COMMERCE.hypothesis: Provenance-aware Experience can reduce source-conflict, entitlement and locality errors in public shopping tasks.
CONSUMER_COMMERCE.strongest_evidence: Three objective read-only cases and three frozen proposed paired-test opportunities.
CONSUMER_COMMERCE.strongest_counterevidence: No paired result, adoption, repeat use or willingness-to-pay evidence.
CONSUMER_COMMERCE.human_intervention_requirement: Separate approval for any paired run; no login, purchase or payment.
CONSUMER_COMMERCE.next_most_informative_action: After DEV execution is unblocked, seek approval for one smallest public read-only P4 or P5 pair.

B2B_AGENT_READINESS.hypothesis: Public workflow diagnostics can reveal where services are not agent-ready.
B2B_AGENT_READINESS.strongest_counterevidence: No concrete recurring pain, candidate, objective outcome or buyer signal.
B2B_AGENT_READINESS.next_most_informative_action: Remain observation-only until a concrete public workflow failure appears.

TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.hypothesis: Receipts, provenance and compatibility boundaries can improve decisions across the other lanes.
TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.strongest_evidence: DEV receipts prevented false transfer claims; commerce cases show why provenance/scope matters.
TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.strongest_counterevidence: No independent buyer pain, paired test, adoption or WTP signal.
TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.plausible_buyer_user: Teams operating agents in DEV or commerce workflows.
TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.next_most_informative_action: Continue as a cross-lane evidence layer; do not launch an independent experiment.

problem_solution_frontier.problem: Merged fixes can pass upstream CI without an independently replayed, verifier-bound record that future agents can trust.
problem_solution_frontier.who_has_it: SDK/framework maintainers and coding-agent evaluation teams.
problem_solution_frontier.current_workaround: Trust the merged patch, review discussion and CI history.
problem_solution_frontier.why_current_solution_fails: It does not preserve a portable red/green replay, rejected approaches, applicability and cost.
problem_solution_frontier.AEG_unique_advantage: Immutable pre/post replay with discriminating oracle, provenance and a portable receipt.
problem_solution_frontier.objective_outcome: #3076 base fails intended trailing-newline tests; repair passes them without valid-name regression.
problem_solution_frontier.data_supply: Public commits and regression tests are available.
problem_solution_frontier.evidence: READY but unclaimed; no AEG outcome.

problem_solution_frontier.problem: Agents can silently resolve conflicting product facts or mistake a displayed price for transaction entitlement/local availability.
problem_solution_frontier.current_workaround: Ad hoc search, source selection and text summarization.
problem_solution_frontier.why_current_solution_fails: Claims often lose source surface, authority, membership and locality scope.
problem_solution_frontier.AEG_unique_advantage: Preserve claim provenance, precedence, entitlement and unresolved conflict state.
problem_solution_frontier.objective_outcome: Lower factual, conflict-suppression and unsupported-entitlement errors on frozen public cases.
problem_solution_frontier.data_supply: Three public cases and frozen sources exist.
problem_solution_frontier.evidence: Read-only Target/Apple, Costco and Home Depot observations; no paired result.
problem_solution_frontier.strongest_counterevidence: No user behavior, repeat use or payment signal.
problem_solution_frontier.next_experiment: One separately approved public P4 or P5 pair after DEV throughput is unblocked.

judgment_items: Repair local budget accounting and external-code isolation under existing authority before allowing #3076 to CLAIM.
Prevent out-of-schedule competitive research from consuming regular daily slot capacity.
Do not add tasks, budget, parallel consumers, repositories, transfer arms or models; use the remaining deadline only for the existing READY task if admission becomes valid.
